meta.scope: Faculty of Humanities & Sciences only. Local A/L requirements only.
knownDataGaps: Nursing's accepted streams include 'Bio Systems Technology' and 'Engineering Technology', which are A/L subjects taken within our generic 'Technology' stream, not separate stream names — mapped to the Technology stream here; may need manual review for borderline cases.

The foundation-certificate alternate admission route (Nursing, LJMU Psychology, Monash Psychology) is intentionally deferred — it doesn't depend on O/L/A/L grades at all, so it needs a different kind of form question and matching logic than everything else in this system. Revisit once the rest of the data is in place.
